n1.text: Sketch v3 (2026-11-02). Numbers shown are the ones the Head of ThinkLatent stated; everything else is a placeholder or an illustrative shape until the telemetry contract (TL-009), the training pipeline and the index feed the pages. Press Play on any screen: links walk the journey. Engineering view reveals lineage and the trace.

n2.text: v3 adds what the five scout briefs found: latency by request shape with p50·p99 and a TTFT split; goodput, error budget and saturation; acceptance and persistence as the quality headline; judge calibration before any judge number; Official vs Practice runs with intervals; a record that is the single governed object; prompts as releases; datasets with lineage; alerts from thresholds plus a weekly digest; usage with forecasts; and the side door made visible.
